Resolves #19456

The tracked Codex template now carries the operator-approved 74 named Neo MCP tool allowances (GitHub Workflow 21, Knowledge Base 7, Memory Core 21, Neural Link 25), so new repo-local setups can inherit the same policy as the GPT peers. Unlisted tools keep the client default. Existing transport, authentication, sandbox and other settings remain unchanged.

Evidence: L2 (parsed template and exact-set/content controls) → L2 required for this template-only change. Residual: none for this ticket; Fleet settings import remains a separate outcome under neomjs/neo-agent-brain#571.

Change class: capability (`feat`). Agent-preflight is not hosted in this Engine checkout; shared PR-body and substrate-size checks run in CI.

These dispositions preserve the approved scope. The actual merge remains with the human operator.
